info.description: This is the API for Auth Service of HealthMate application.
info.title: HealthMate API

post.description: Authenticates a user using email and password, returns access/refresh tokens.
Authenticates a user using a Google ID token and returns access/refresh tokens.
Logs the user out by invalidating the provided refresh token.
Generates and sends a new OTP to the user's email if the account is unverified.

200.description: Always returns a success message for security reasons

409.description: Returned if account is already verified

post.description: Verifies OTP and logs the user in by returning tokens.
Sets a password for the currently authenticated user. Requires Bearer token.
Provides a new access token if the given refresh token is valid.
Creates a new user account with email, password, and name.

get.description: Get all groups (owned or joined) for the current user

post.description: Create a new group with the current user as owner

get.summary: List group invitations of current user

get.description: Get all available health metric types that can be shared

put.description: Update name and description of a group

get.description: List pending invitations (Owner sees all, Members see their own)
get.summary: List group invitations which the current user is invited to

get.description: List all members of a group (Members only)

post.description: Send an invitation to a user by email

put.description: Accept or reject a group invitation

delete.description: Leave a group you are a member of
Kick a member from the group (Owner only)

put.description: Transfer group ownership to a new user

get.description: Get current user's sharing permissions in a group

put.description: Update all sharing permissions for the current user

post.description: Enable or disable sharing for a specific metric type

get.description: Retrieve a list of users with optional search and pagination
Get profile details of the currently authenticated user

put.description: Update profile details (name, picture) of the current user

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
